behavior: A reviewer that writes a probe test and edits a tracked file leaves the caller's git status outside specs/<id>/ unchanged; inside it only the slot's outputs change, and the review file and transcript arrive
verification: cd cli && go test -v ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestReviewInWorktreeLeavesCallerTreeUntouched$' -count=1 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestReviewInWorktreeLeavesCallerTreeUntouched'

behavior: The same run names both stray paths on stderr and exits 4
verification: cd cli && go test -v ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestReviewInWorktreeStillReportsStrayWrites$' -count=1 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestReviewInWorktreeStillReportsStrayWrites'

behavior: The slot's outputs (review-second.md for --second) are copied back and the review worktree removed on exit 0, 4, 124 and 125; an interrupted cleanup leaves a labelled, lease-free worktree that sweep removes
verification: cd cli && out=$(go test -v ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/worktree/ -run '^(TestDeadlineCopiesBackAndRemovesReviewWorktree|TestReviewWorktreeSwept)$' -count=1 2>&1) && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestDeadlineCopiesBackAndRemovesReviewWorktree' && printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestReviewWorktreeSwept'

behavior: Both runners work in the review worktree: agy --add-dir, the tmux start directory and the prompt name it
verification: cd cli && go test -v ./internal/spec/ ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestReviewLaunchUsesReviewWorktree$' -count=1 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestReviewLaunchUsesReviewWorktree'

behavior: spec review refuses a caller tree with a tracked change or untracked file outside specs/<id>/ unless --allow-dirty; dirt inside specs/<id>/ does not refuse
verification: cd cli && go test -v ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestReviewRefusesDirtyTreeWithoutAllowDirty$' -count=1 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestReviewRefusesDirtyTreeWithoutAllowDirty'

behavior: A second-round first-signer review in the worktree finds the caller's uncommitted first-round verdict as review-round1.md
verification: cd cli && go test -v ./internal/cmd/ -run '^TestReviewWorktreeCarriesEarlierRounds$' -count=1 2>&1 | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestReviewWorktreeCarriesEarlierRounds'
